title: Relative pseudo-coherence of a complex on a space over a ring tested against all pseudo-coherent pairings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For A a ring, X separated of finite presentation over A and K in D_QCoh(O_X): if RGamma(X, E (x) K) is pseudo-coherent in D(A) for every pseudo-coherent E, then K is pseudo-coherent relative to A. The retained proof is complete: it is the spaces Fourier-Mukai engine run once — pick the derived-Chow data (n, Z, z, V, E) of the chapter's derived Chow lemma, project p from X x P^n and q to P^n_A; a three-line chain of derived base-change identities (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma cohomology-base-change) rewrites the twisted RGamma on projective space as the assumed-pseudo-coherent pairing on X; properness of p feeds the flat-proper-pseudo-coherent direct image lemma to justify each hypothesis; projective-space pseudo-coherence detection (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma pseudo-coherent-on-projective-space) lands Rq_*(Lp^*K (x) E) pseudo-coherent on P^n_A; restriction to V is computed by the chapter's Fourier-Mukai evaluation lemma (same wave, L16215) as the closed immersion pushforward R(W -> V)_* K|_W, and charts-relative-pseudo-coherence (More on Morphisms, lemma check-relative-pseudo-coherence-on-charts, card L16132) pulls the conclusion back to K on an etale neighbourhood of every point. Retained author proof at lines 12174-12227.
